interactions.speaker: Echo
dialogues: The crystal transforms into a faded red warning flag.
For coastal villages, respecting this warning was never a sign of fear—it was a sign of wisdom and respect for nature.

interactions.speaker: Echo
dialogues: The sea provides life, but it also demands humility.
Generations of fishermen learned that no harvest is worth risking a life.

interactions.speaker: Vino
dialogues: This flag protected an entire village.
Sometimes true courage means knowing when not to challenge the sea.
